description: This file defines the PersistentStateAttribute class, a custom attribute used to specify options for persistent state configuration in Orleans. It includes properties for state name and storage provider, and is applied to constructor parameters.

classes.name: PersistentStateAttribute
classes.description: A custom attribute class used to specify persistent state options for Orleans components, including state name and storage provider.

methods.name: PersistentStateAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute with a state name and optional storage name, throwing an exception if the state name is null.
